summary: Iter 629 (Paket 32) — 3 features tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter629_paket32.py. (1) POST /api/maintenance/issues with photos_before=[data:image/png;base64...,'/api/uploads/maintenance/x.png'] → response photos_before is list of 2 dicts, both url starts '/api/uploads/maintenance/', uploaded_by present, type='before'; first (data-URL) has source='hk_mobile'; GET the saved URL returns 200 image/png. Passthrough of dict-shaped photo objects preserved. (2) Accountant flow: PUT /api/tr-compliance/efatura/default/settings {accountant_email:'muhasebe@example.com', accountant_name:'Ayşe'} → 200 (settings echoed inside {ok,settings}). POST /archive/send {month:'2026-09'} → 200 {count=81, total>0, email_status='mocked', auto:false}. Month '2031-01' → 404. Empty accountant_email → 422 (restored after). GET /archive/history returns list without 'token' field. Mongo tr_einvoice_archives newest token used to GET /api/tr-compliance/efatura/archive-download/{token} (no auth) → 200 application/zip, valid ZIP with xml/ + pdf/ + ozet_YYYY-MM.csv. Bad token → 404. email_outbox has kind='efatura_archive' entries containing the token link. (3) A/B auto-close worker: called _ab_auto_close(db) directly with motor. Setup: set QANOW10 post title_b='Şimdi rezerve et, %10 kazan!', ab_auto_n=5, insert 6 view + 3 cta_click site_visits for variant B on blog/{slug}. Also set QAWIN20 ab_auto_n=100000 as untouched control. After await: QANOW10 title = title_b text, title_b='', ab_winner='B', ab_auto_closed=True, ab_result present. QAWIN20 untouched. Restore performed (title, title_b, ab_auto_n=200, ab_winner='', ab_auto_closed=False, delete qa-ab- site_visits). Also verified POST /api/site-builder/default persists ab_auto_n (GET → change QANOW10 ab_auto_n to 300 → POST back → GET shows 300 → restore 200). Frontend Playwright PASS: (a) Gallery — logged in, sidebar ops-v2-btn → ops-tab-requests → clicked issue 'Oda 104 — Tesisat (galeri test)' → detail-tab-photos → issue-gallery-open text contains '2 önce' → click opens photo-lightbox with lightbox-counter='1 / 2', lightbox-kind='ÖNCE / BEFORE'; lightbox-next → '2 / 2'; ArrowLeft → '1 / 2'; lightbox-thumb-1 → '2 / 2'; Escape closes. Click issue-photo-before-1 directly → opens at '2 / 2'. (b) Site Builder → Blog & Kampanyalar: site-post-ab-1 present with site-post-ab-auto-n-1 value='200' and site-post-ab-progress-1 bar + text 'ziyaretçi — eşikte kazanan otomatik uygulanır'. Also seen ids: site-post-ab-0/-1, -auto-n-1, -progress-1, -1-A/-B, -apply-1-A/-B. (c) Finance → e-invoice-btn → tr-efatura-settings-toggle → tr-efatura-accountant-box visible with tr-efatura-accountant-email='muhasebe@example.com'; set tr-efatura-bulk-month='2026-09' → click tr-efatura-archive-send → toast 'Arşiv muhasebeciye gönderildi (81 fatura, mocked)'.
critical_code_review_comments: tr_compliance._send_archive uses PUBLIC_BASE_URL for the token link in the email body but the endpoint is unauthenticated and lives 90 days by convention only — no expires_at is stored on tr_einvoice_archives so links effectively never expire. Add expires_at and check on download.

workers._ab_auto_close: uses positional Python dict mutation on the fetched posts list then $set on content.posts of the doc — race with any concurrent site-builder save (POST /site-builder/{id}) will silently overwrite either side. Consider optimistic concurrency via updated_at or targeted array element $set.

tr_compliance._build_archive: query uses issue_date $lte '{month}-31' which is a lexical safety net but months with 30/31 vs invoices dated as full ISO datetime strings would slip out; using $lt next-month-01 is more correct.

maintenance._normalize_photos: 10MB+ base64 data-URLs are decoded and written to object_storage synchronously in-request; large photo batches may block event loop. Also no MIME/size validation on the decoded bytes.

site_builder POST whitelist ensures ab_auto_n is clamped 20..100000 — good; but ab_winner input from client is trusted only if in ('A','B'), the field ab_result is dropped (worker-only). Confirm intended.
